Theorem
[Representation formula using Green's function] ↗ def:greens-function 1. ch2:2.2-thm-12\group Green’s Functions

If $u\in C^2(\overline U)$ satisfies \[ -\Delta u=f\ \text{in }U, \qquad u=g\ \text{on }\partial U, \] then \[ (30)\qquad u(x)=-\int _{\partial U}g(y)\frac{\partial G}{\partial \nu }(x,y)\, dS(y) +\int _U f(y)G(x,y)\, dy. \]
